audit_method: Post-grant live check using the signed-in staging browser plus repository verification. The Neon permission grant was explicitly confirmed by the user and executed in the Neon SQL editor. No credentials or tokens were recorded; no GPU, RunPod, resource allocation, or paid compute action occurred.

grant_fix.defect: The runtime role lacked EXECUTE on videoforge_current_account_id(), which is called by tenant RLS policies. Google sign-in had created the auth/session rows, but /api/v2/tenant failed with a Cloudflare 1101 permission-denied exception.
grant_fix.sql_executed: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.videoforge_current_account_id() TO videoforge_v2_06_runtime;
grant_fix.result: Neon SQL editor reported Statement executed successfully.

live_browser_observation.queue: API healthy; authenticated Queue loaded; worker state WAITING FOR YOUR COMPUTER
live_browser_observation.settings: My workspace; TENANT ISOLATED; Mac .dmg and Windows .exe links; No computer is connected yet
live_browser_observation.interpretation: The grant restored the authenticated hosted tenant bootstrap/UI path. It does not prove a desktop install, pairing, media execution, or hosted generation completion.

findings.finding: Full V2-06 acceptance remains open: a native personal worker is not installed or paired, so Windows/macOS lifecycle, offline/reconnect, cancellation, streamed R2 output, media parity, and hosted end-to-end generation are unproven. Durable Workflow recovery, backup/restore, explicit output deletion, and post-acceptance billing observation are also unproven.
findings.next_user_action: From Settings, run the downloaded Mac or Windows beta installer and click Connect this computer in the signed-in browser. The worker must be installed/launched by the user; no credentials or configuration are required.

findings.finding: Provider-free local and installed-Chrome tests are green but cannot substitute for hosted personal-worker/device proof or a second real Google account isolation run.
Rollback and restore remain documented but not exercised against the live Worker/Neon deployment.

verification_commands.result: all canonical package, control-plane, Python, Workerd, and installed-Chrome suites green; 44/44 Chrome tests passed
provider-free deployment templates are fail-closed and internally consistent, including the tenant-principal grant

successor_safety.reason: V2-06 full acceptance remains open; no RunPod/GPU authority was granted.
